name: top-spend-events
description: top-K spending events and deterministic tie ordering

queries.name: expensive-events
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events ORDER BY amount DESC, event_id DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: paid-top-events
queries.sql: SELECT event_id, amount FROM events WHERE status = 'paid' ORDER BY amount DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 20
